_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored.
_client_path: Path to the ziniao client. null = auto-detect (see bootstrap.py). Windows V6: ziniao.exe, V5: starter.exe. macOS: 'ziniao'. Linux: /opt/ziniao/ziniaobrowser
_client_version: v5 or v6 - decides the process name when killing the client (SuperBrowser.exe vs ziniao.exe)
_socket_port: Any free local port. The client listens here for HTTP IPC.
_driver_folder_path: Fallback chromedriver dir, relative to the project. Usually unused - each store core ships its own webdriver.exe.
_user_info: Enterprise login (企业登录). The account needs WebDriver permission enabled in the ziniao console.
_stores: default = store used when --store is omitted. allowed = the only stores that may be opened; empty list means unrestricted. batch = the stores run_batch.py walks, in order; empty means all of allowed.
